summary: Missing Louisville woman found deceased near Gross Reservoir (Osprey Parking Lot, unincorporated Boulder County); Denver Water Board reported a suspicious vehicle, BCSO mobilized ~7:40 a.m. search with ~24 personnel; body located ~1 p.m., recovery complete 3:40 p.m.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Front Range Rescue Dogs; Louisville Police Department; Coal Creek Fire Protection District
notes: BCSO case 19-7046; woman reported missing to Louisville PD 2019-12-07; official BCSO release opened run 688; death not considered suspicious; cause/manner per Boulder County Coroner; Denver Water Board + coroner also on scene
